description: Receive one envelope and verify it (spec §9 steps 1–7).

cases.description: A well-formed SendMessage request from alice to bob.
The valid envelope with whitespace, reversed member order and unnecessary escapes. Verification uses the parsed value, so it still verifies.
Unknown members at the top level, in ctx and in the body are covered by the signature and ignored.
Body numbers spelled differently from their JCS form (1.0E-1, 0.00000010, 4.2e1, and 9.007199254740991E15 = 2^53 − 1) canonicalise to what was signed. A 64-bit value travels as a string.
Non-ASCII text, surrogate-pair escapes and metadata keys whose UTF-16 order differs from code point order (U+1F600 sorts before U+FB33).
A oneof member (Part.text) and an optional field (historyLength) set to their default values are emitted, as the signer form requires.
exp − ts equals MAX_TTL (7 days).
Delivered 50 minutes after ts (far more than SKEW) but before exp: accepted.
now = exp + SKEW exactly: still fresh.
ts = now + SKEW exactly: accepted.
bob's response to the baseline request, received by alice's node.
A sender-declared trust member is signed and kept but has no effect (provenance/v0 ignores it).
An extension operation (URI#name). Its body is not an A2A schema, so only the generic rules apply.
A relay changes `to` from bob to carol, both hosted on the receiving node.
A mailbox host extends `exp` by a day.
An intermediary swaps the capability token.
An intermediary replaces the taint owners (laundering provenance).
The body text is changed, body_hash left as signed.
The body is changed and body_hash recomputed to match: the signature over the header fails.
An intermediary adds an unknown top-level member. Unknown members are signed, so this breaks the signature.

cases.description: An intermediary removes `cap`.
GetTask and CancelTask bodies have the same shape. Changing the signed `op` breaks the signature.
A valid GetTask envelope delivered in a frame that names CancelTask: the signed op wins and the mismatch is rejected.
from = alice, but signed with mallory's key.
Signed over JCS(signed header) without the `webway-envelope/0` 0x00 prefix.
Signed over the envelope minus sig (body included) instead of the signed header.
The valid signature with S replaced by S + L. Verifiers that reduce S mod L would accept it (malleability).
from is the identity point (small order) and the signature is (R = identity, S = 0), which satisfies the verification equation for every message.
from encodes a curve point with y ≥ p (a non-canonical encoding of a valid point).
The signature's R is the identity point.
The `v` member is absent.
The `typ` member is absent.
The `op` member is absent.
The `from` member is absent.
The `to` member is absent.
The `id` member is absent.
The `ts` member is absent.
The `exp` member is absent.
The `body_hash` member is absent.
The `body` member is absent.
The `sig` member is absent.

cases.description: v = webway-envelope/1.
typ = notify.
from in uppercase base32.
from with non-zero unused trailing bits: decodes to alice's key under a lax decoder.
id is a version 4 UUID.
ts uses +00:00 instead of Z.
ts has 2 fractional digits (only 0, 3, 6 or 9 are allowed).
body_hash in uppercase hex.
sig with base64 padding.
sig uses + and / (standard alphabet) instead of - and _.
sig decodes to 63 bytes.
cap.access is a number.
The envelope is a JSON array.
exp = ts.
exp − ts = MAX_TTL + 1 s.
now = exp + SKEW + 1 s.
ts = now + SKEW + 90 s: retryable, retryAfter = 90.
Fresh by the clock, but exp + SKEW ≤ the receiver's purge watermark.
Validly signed for carol, delivered to a node that hosts only bob.
A response without ctx.inReplyTo.
op is neither an A2A method nor an extension URI#name.
role as the enum number 1 instead of "ROLE_USER".
message_id (proto name) instead of messageId.
tenant present with its default value "".
role = ROLE_UNSPECIFIED (the default) emitted explicitly.
Part.raw as base64 without padding.
ctx.contextId differs from body.message.contextId.
Two Parts, taint for only the first.
A body with a Part and no prov member.
A prov entry without taint.
A prov key that does not resolve to a Part.
taint.owners is empty.
Two `to` members (carol, then bob). Parsers that keep the first or the last would disagree.
`role` and `\u0072ole` are the same name once unescaped.
A plain integer 9007199254740993 (2^53 + 1) in body metadata.
1e16 in body metadata: an unsafe integral value, whatever its spelling.
1e400 in body metadata.
A lone high-surrogate escape in a Part's text.
A trailing comma after the last member.
A byte 0xFF inside a string (given as input_hex).
Body metadata nested 70 arrays deep (over MAX_DEPTH = 64).
